summary: Tested iteration 15 features: Print agent PS1/BAT downloads + admin recovery code flow (generate/status/recover/reuse/lockout) and forgot-password UI. Backend: 16/17 tests pass. Frontend: full recover flow works end-to-end. One backend bug found: brute-force lockout throws 500 due to naive-vs-aware datetime comparison in /api/auth/recover.

critical.issue: After 5 failed attempts, the 6th (or later) call raises 500 instead of 429. Root cause in server.py:367 — MongoDB returns `lockout_until` as a naive datetime, but code compares it with `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` (aware). Traceback: TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes. Fix: either store as ISO string/aware via tz_aware Mongo client, or coerce on read: `lu = attempts['lockout_until']; if lu.tzinfo is None: lu = lu.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)`.

action_items: Fix naive/aware datetime comparison in /api/auth/recover lockout check (server.py line 367) so 6th failed attempt returns 429 instead of 500.

Positive: recovery code endpoints correctly use hashed storage (recovery_hash), single-use ($unset on success), and admin role gating; kasir gets 403 as required.

Frontend Settings is at /admin/settings, not /settings. LoginPage forgot-password button opens RecoverPasswordDialog with testids input-recover-name/code/password/confirm and btn-submit-recover. Ensure login_attempts collection is cleaned before re-running brute-force test.
rca of the issue: In /app/backend/server.py:367 the code compares `datetime.now(timezone.utc) < attempts['lockout_until']`. `attempts['lockout_until']` is written via `datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(...)` (aware), but Motor/PyMongo by default decodes BSON datetimes as naive UTC (tz_aware=False). Comparing aware < naive raises TypeError → FastAPI returns 500. Reproduction: POST /api/auth/recover 5 times with any wrong code for the same name, then a 6th call returns 500. Mitigation: pass `tz_aware=True` to AsyncIOMotorClient OR normalize on read: `lu = attempts['lockout_until']; lu = lu if lu.tzinfo else lu.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)`.
